Mateo / team,

Draft answers below for the items Patricia requested. Leaving inline notes where procurement/security might want further evidence.

1) TAM coverage model
- Primary model: named TAM for onboarding + pooled TAM coverage for ongoing ops. Named TAM assigned for first 90 days post-go-live; after that, primary contact remains but day-to-day is handled via pooled rotations.
- Coverage hours: 9am-6pm local business hours (named TAM) + 24/7 pooled on-call for Sev1 incidents.
- Escalation path: Tier 1 (Support Desk) -> Tier 2 (Pooled TAMs) -> Tier 3 (Engineering on-call) -> Exec notified for prolonged degradation (>4 hours).

2) Incident communications
- Sev1: initial acknowledgement within 15 minutes; continuous updates every 30 minutes until mitigated; post-incident report within 48 hours.
- Sev2: ack within 60 minutes; updates every 2 hours; RCA within 7 business days if root cause confirmed.
- Sev3: ack within 4 business hours; next-business-day update; RCA on request.

3) On-call roster / overlap
- We maintain regional on-call pools for US / EU / APAC. For trans-regional coverage we guarantee handoff overlap of at least 2 hours between shifts. See attached: tam_roster.csv and oncall-schedule.pdf (redacted contact info shown).

4) Monitoring & audit evidence
- We can provide a sample incident ticket export (Jira) and anonymized UTC timeline. SOC2 report available under NDA — we can provide cert page and point-in-time audit logs (via secure share).

Maintenance windows
- Standard weekly maintenance: Sundays 02:00–04:00 UTC (announced 48 hours prior). Major upgrades: scheduled with 5-business-day notice and optional blackout windows for customers on Dedicated/Private deployments.

Open items for Patricia: specify whether FinEdge prefers named TAMs for each region (we can accommodate, but commit terms differ). Also confirm whether you need full resumes for named TAMs.

Attachments: tam_roster.csv (CSV — redacted), oncall-schedule.pdf (PDF)

-marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Hi Patricia — please find our consolidated response attached. Highlights below and the full appendix is attached as PDF.

Key points:
- Named TAM during onboarding (first 90 days) with an option to maintain named TAMs thereafter via contract addendum.
- 24/7 pooled on-call for Sev1, regional pools for US/EU/APAC with minimum 2-hour handoffs.
- Response targets: Sev1 ack <15m, Sev2 ack <60m, Sev3 ack <4h. Post-incident report for Sev1 within 48h.
- We can provide sample incident ticket exports (Jira) and anonymized timelines; SOC2 evidence provided via secure share after NDA.
- Maintenance: weekly Sunday window 02:00–04:00 UTC; customer-specific blackout windows negotiable for Dedicated/Private deployments.

Attachments: Redwood_RFI_Support_Response_20261120.pdf (consolidated RFI answers + runbook appendix)
